work_info.title: What is Photo Clipping Path?
descriptions: Photo Clipping Path is a precise digital editing technique used to isolate objects or properties from their backgrounds. It enables clean, professional images for listings, marketing materials, or virtual presentations by allowing controlled background replacement or enhancement.

list.content: Object Isolation: Creating accurate outlines around property elements, furniture, or products.
Background Removal & Replacement: Replacing unwanted backgrounds with clean or customized visuals.
Edge Refinement & Detailing: Ensuring crisp, smooth edges for professional quality.
Color & Tone Adjustment: Maintaining natural look after background edits.
Marketing-Ready Output: Producing images optimized for web, brochures, or virtual tours.
